Yet the moment we all\ngo online, something kind of astonishing happens.\n\nOur voices, they all disappear, and you hear\nnothing but crickets, and you see nothing\n\nbut text. What's up with that? Did we leave\nour best communication tool behind us because\n\ntext is better? I don’t think. We stopped\nusing our voices to talk to each other because\n\nthe Internet didn't support voices, but that's\njust not the case anymore. Instead of texting\n\napps, forms, or emailing, you have another\noption. Just grab some media, upload it, and\n\nand share. Then listen as voices are added\nand the conversation grows naturally over\n\ntime without anyone scheduling anything. Simply\nput, VoiceThreading will get you back to using\n\nthe most effective communications tool ever\nmade, which will make your online meetings,\n\npresentations, or conversations more effective,\nbut also more personal and, basically, more\n\nhuman.","description":"OLC"}</script></head>
